core_categories: Medical Devices; Pharmaceuticals; Disposable Medical Products; Medical Equipment; Diagnostic Equipment; Surgical Instruments
specialty_focus: Williams Medical Supplies is a manufacturer, distributor, and service provider of healthcare products, specializing in primary care as the largest supplier to GP surgeries and community healthcare facilities in the UK. It also supports secondary care and clinical markets, offering a range of products including surgical instruments, pharmaceuticals, and diagnostic equipment. The company does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
